title: Cold rebuild: attribute actions
summary: Rebuild the attributes processor's insert, update, upsert, delete and hash from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: You wrote **Apply attribute actions** in *Processors: protect, clean, sample*. Write it again from an **empty editor**.
Why this one? Redaction is the Collector job with legal consequences. Knowing exactly what `insert` does to an existing key, or
what `hash` does to a missing one, is what lets you review a teammate's config change with confidence.

steps.prompt: `{ key: env, value: prod, action: insert }` runs on a span that already has `env = staging`. Result?
options: `env = staging`: insert only adds missing keys
steps.explain: insert = add if missing, update = change if present, upsert = always set.

steps.title: Rebuild Apply cold
prompt: Write `Dictionary<string, string> Apply(Dictionary<string, string> attrs, List<AttrAction> actions)` again, from memory: a new
dictionary, actions in order; `insert` (if missing), `update` (if present), `upsert` (always), `delete`, `hash` (SHA-256, lower-case
hex, only if present). `record AttrAction(string Key, string Action, string? Value = null);` is given.
